remarks: Completely and thoughtfully renovated, this exceptional New Canaan residence blends timeless architecture with refined modern luxury in a magical private setting overlooking the Noroton River and cascading waterfalls. Located on one of New Canaan's most coveted Westside streets, the home enjoys a close-knit neighborhood known for friendly gatherings and neighborhood parties. The heart of the home is a chef's kitchen with Viking appliances, custom white oak island and pantry, and Mont Blanc quartz countertops. Designer finishes include newly renovated baths, a recycled glass and concrete bar top, imported European wallpaper murals, and Restoration Hardware lighting. Architectural details such as hidden bookcase doors, refinished wood floors, and a dramatic slide-and-stack door system create seamless indoor-outdoor living filled with natural light.The main residence offers soaring ceilings, four fireplaces, a sun-filled library, expansive primary suite, three additional bedrooms, office, and a finished lower level with recreation room and gym. In addition to the main residence, this unique home features a separate yet attached two-bedroom, two-bath flex wing perfect as an in-law, guest or au-pair suite with living, dining, and eat-in kitchen. Outdoors,enjoy a heated Gunite pool, stunning fruit trees and vegetable garden as well as tranquil river views. New roof, Generator and energy-efficient heat pump. Welcome to your sanctuary in one of New Canaan's most special settings
